answer: A practical defense is to require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can earn fees, then slash that stake when its signed actions are proven fraudulent through an auditable dispute process. One person can still create many identities, but each must lock real value and risk losing it; the cost therefore grows with the number of sybils, rather than relying on usernames or device fingerprints. A walnut, timber, or copper trader faces the same rule: reputation helps, but it does not replace collateral.
